result.summary: The pedestrian environment includes basic infrastructure such as sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded and worn. Parked vehicles near the intersection create visual obstructions, and the lack of high-visibility treatments or active traffic control increases exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with a sidewalk on the left side, but it lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and overgrown vegetation along the walkway create a less-than-ideal environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway.

hazards.name: Overgrown vegetation
hazards.description: Tall grass and weeds along the sidewalk edge may reduce the effective width of the path and obstruct sightlines.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing locations.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the corners to provide accessible transitions between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly trim overgrown grass and weeds to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is usable and sightlines are clear.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The environment is characterized by uncontrolled vehicle movements and sightline obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the corners.
